base_url.correction: https://global-api.afterpay.com (or region-specific hosts such as https://api.us.afterpay.com / https://api.eu.afterpay.com per docs; entry’s generic https://api.afterpay.com is not the documented production base)

auth_type.correction: basic (HTTP Basic Auth with Merchant ID as username and Secret Key as password)

example.correction: Documented calls use region/global hosts and Basic Auth, e.g. curl -u MERCHANT_ID:SECRET_KEY https://global-api.afterpay.com/v2/configuration — not unauthenticated GET https://api.afterpay.com/

notes: Entry’s base URL and example path look invented; auth is Basic not “other/unknown”. Docs live at developers.afterpay.com; merchant API is not a free public tier. Rate limits and CORS not clearly published for browser use.
